paper_metadata.title: High temperature deformation behavior of a novel Nb–Si based ultrahigh temperature alloy

evidence.quote: The high temperature deformation behavior of an optimized Nb–Si based ultrahigh temperature alloy was investigated by isothermal compression.

Cylindrical samples with 8 mm in diameter and 12 mm in height were cut from the ingot for compressive tests. Isothermal compression tests were conducted on a Gleeble-3500 thermo-mechanical simulator at temperatures ranging from 1200 to 1300 °C and strain rates of 0.001 –0.05 s−1, with a total height reduction of 30%.
